name: OR-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about six points on the partisan baseline
Salinas is an incumbent with a large fundraising edge ($1.6M raised vs. $13K for Russ)
Prediction markets price the Democratic side near 97%
No public general-election polling, so the forecast rests on fundamentals
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Salinas: a Democratic-leaning seat, incumbency, and an overwhelming money advantage over a challenger who has raised almost nothing. Markets agree, so the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin with only a slight trim.
model.watch: Any late surge of outside Republican spending or a polling surprise showing a tighter race would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Andrea Salinas seeks a second term in a district that leans Democratic by about six points, in a favorable national environment for her party. She has raised about $1.6 million and holds over $600,000 on hand, while Republican David Russ has raised roughly $13,000 with essentially no cash reserve and no visible outside support. No independent groups are spending against her.

With no public polls and no expert ratings, the race is judged on fundamentals and market pricing, both of which point to a comfortable Democratic hold. The main uncertainty is the absence of polling rather than any specific sign of weakness for the incumbent.
